sources.title: README.md
sources.finding: Corgi is a terminal multiplexer for humans and agents powered by Ghostty; install script for macOS Apple Silicon or Linux amd64/arm64; detects claude, codex, pi, opencode and omp panes, installs hooks, shows status, subagents, usage, rename/fork, resume after crash, multiple accounts; corgi list/tab/pane/message/read scripting; MIT.

sources.title: LICENSE
sources.finding: MIT License, copyright Tal Shiri and Corgi contributors; notification sounds from herdr remain Apache-2.0.

sources.title: docs/reference.md
sources.locator: Set up and import; Tabs and panes; Review changes; Ask Corgi; Script Corgi; Settings and troubleshooting
sources.finding: Setup and import from tmux, herdr, cmux; tabs, panes and workspaces; review panel; Ask Corgi prompt with memory; scripting commands; state under ~/.local/state/corgi; remote work by running ssh -t host corgi so detaching leaves the runtime on that host.

sources.title: docs/agents.md
sources.locator: Providers; Conversation ownership; Children, usage and context; Inference and data boundaries
sources.finding: Each provider is an adapter (Claude Code, Codex, Pi, OpenCode, Oh My Pi) with hooks or extensions; daemon owns a conversation actor per provider session; children and usage are observed; summary inference uses a private worker whose provider can differ from the observed agent.

sources.title: docs/agent-launcher.md
sources.locator: Start an agent; Several accounts; YOLO
sources.finding: Agent picker starts or resumes agents; each provider can have several accounts (CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, CODEX_HOME folders) with usage; per-provider YOLO checkbox off by default.

sources.title: docs/workspaces.md
sources.locator: Follow activity; Hibernate; Create or choose a worktree; Browse and compare worktrees
sources.finding: Workspace indicators for working, needs input, unread; jump to attention; hibernate and archive; create a git worktree from the agent picker; browse and compare worktrees; push unpushed commits.

sources.title: docs/releases.md
sources.finding: Publisher builds macOS arm64 and Linux amd64/arm64, signs a manifest, serves it from https://corgi.computer; releases are not published on GitHub; test builds do not send crash reports; optional Sentry.

sources.title: assets/help.txt
sources.finding: corgi start/attach, open, onboard, update with rollback, hooks, integration, account, headless start/list/send/events/stop, watch --json, usage --json, rpc, reload, checkpoint, shutdown, bugreport; workspaces group tabs and panes, no worktrees note.

sources.title: assets/corgi-skill.md
sources.finding: corgi --skill prints agent instructions: list, tab and pane commands, message agents, pane read, grep conversations, headless sessions, usage.

sources.title: HACKING.md
sources.finding: Zig native layer with Ghostty, Bun TypeScript daemon and viewer; release builds configured with Sentry report daemon and viewer crashes; development builds have no DSN.

sources.title: src/telemetry.ts
sources.finding: Opt-in aggregate timings and a bounded timeline written locally, enabled by CORGI_TELEMETRY; no network I/O in the module.

sources.title: src/crash.ts
sources.finding: Crash reporter uploads to a Sentry DSN only when a release build sets one (src/build_config.ts default is empty).

sources.title: scripts/install.sh.in
sources.finding: Installer script served at corgi.computer/install.sh for macOS Apple Silicon and Linux.

sources.title: src/providers.ts
sources.finding: Provider adapters registered in UI order: claude, codex, pi, opencode, omp.

sources.title: docs/remote.md
sources.finding: Default-branch (not in stable release 03c72b7) documentation for corgi machine add and --machine: each machine keeps its own daemon; no Corgi network listener, account service or hosted relay.
